children: Kenya's cabinet has approved $350 million in shareholder financing for Kenya Airways
to meet urgent financial obligations, President William Ruto's office said on Friday.

The cabinet also endorsed a proposed conversion of Kenya Airways' 122 billion Kenyan shillings ($941.36 million) in government loans into an equity-qualifying tradable instrument, Ruto's office said in a statement.
